The Processing Pattern dictates we process logs into planks first. Dependencies include collecting logs and crafting sticks using planks. The crafting of the final item (wooden_sword) will be the last step. 

Referencing the examples, I follow the step structure pattern: collect → process → craft components → craft final item.
